name: Bard, King of Dale
oracle_text:
Reach, vigilance
If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
blocked_sentences: If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.

needs.what: a card-authorable replacement effect on a player's draws: 'if you would draw a card, draw N cards instead', with an exemption for the first card drawn in each of that player's draw steps. Shaped like the existing player-wide statics -- a static ability effect (say `replace_draw`) carrying a `draw_multiplier` (2 here, the way `replace_life_loss` carries `loss_multiplier`) and a flag or condition for 'except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps'. It has to be a replacement rather than a trigger, and it needs a draw-step-relative counter the engine does not keep: `cards_drawn_this_turn` is per turn, not per draw step, so it cannot tell the first draw of the draw step from the first draw of the turn on a turn where something drew during upkeep.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Nothing in `static_effects` touches a draw except `skip_draw_step`, which cancels the step rather than replacing a draw. `replace_life_loss` is the closest existing shape -- a static whose `loss_multiplier` doubles the size of an event the card never names -- but it is wired to life loss only, and `replace_token_creation` is the only other player-wide replacement static. The four whitelisted `ReplacementModel` events (`self_enters`, `self_enters_tapped`, `self_enters_with_counters`, `self_enters_prepared`) all modify a permanent that is already arriving, so a draw cannot be one of them. The engine does replace draws in exactly one place -- `src/automtg/engine/replacements.py:draw`, which offers dredge and miracle card by card -- and that path is hard-coded to those two mechanics with no hook a card file can name. The `draw` trigger event would fire only after the draw has happened, so 'draw two instead' would become 'draw an extra one afterwards': a different card against Notion Thief, against replacement-ordering, and against anything that counts the draw event, which is exactly the approximation this brief forbids.

needs.what: a count multiplier on `replace_token_creation` -- Doubling Season / Parallel Lives / Anointed Procession: 'if one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead'. The multiplied tokens are *those* tokens, whatever they were, so the static needs something like a `token_multiplier: 2` that scales the pending count while keeping the pending id, alongside the existing id-substituting `create_instead`. It must still respect 614.5 (a replacement applies once per event, so a doubler does not re-double its own output) and stay the token controller's replacement, exactly as `_token_creation_plan` already does for the substitution case.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `replace_token_creation` is the right static but the wrong axis: `create_instead` is a closed list of token ids and each pending token becomes *one of each id in that list*, which is how Academy Manufactor makes one of each and how Divine Visitation preserves N. Doubling an arbitrary token would mean naming the token that was about to be created, and this card names none -- `affects_token` is omitted for 'one or more tokens', and there is no 'the same token again' value for `create_instead`, whose ids are validated against the token pool by `loader.validate_token_references`. `src/automtg/engine/primitives.py:_token_creation_plan` says so in its own docstring: 'There is no count multiplier and no mode flag, because neither card needs one... a third card of a different shape -- a count multiplier such as Doubling Season ... is more engine work rather than a new row in a card file.' Listing a specific id twice in `create_instead` would double only that one token and would silently convert every other token the player makes into it. `create_token`'s `amount` is on the creating effect, not on the replacement, so it cannot see a token creation from another card.

notes: The first printed line is already done by the free tier: `keywords: ["reach", "vigilance"]` on a 3/5 Legendary Creature -- Human Noble Archer for {4}{W}{U}. Once both replacements exist the card is two static abilities and nothing else, and its expectation would be the weak-but-honest `{"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}`: the sandbox casts the card and stops, so neither replacement can be made to fire -- no draw and no token creation happens after it resolves. Note the two needs are independent work items: `token_doubling` is a bounded extension of a static the engine already consults in one place, while `draw_doubling` is a new replacement point plus a per-draw-step draw counter.
